name: Watch Your Heads!

passive_description.localized: Increases ATK by <lv>{0}</> and Lakshana DMG to targets affected by Remora and Stain by <lv>{1}</> for <lv>{2}</>s after the wearer casts a Redirect Skill. Effect does not stack.
passive_description.source: 装备者释放「变轨技能」后攻击力提高<lv>{0}</>，且对受到「延滞」和「浸染」影响的单位造成的相属性异能伤害提高<lv>{1}</>，持续<lv>{2}</>秒，该效果无法叠加。

tested_hypotheses: Admitted Redirect Skill casts grant the wearer-only ATK percentage instance before same-time hits; Normal, Ultimate and QTE casts do not grant.
The instance neither stacks nor refreshes: a recast inside the 15s window keeps the first expiry (RefreshPolicy::Disallow).
The ATK bonus adds base-stat-scaled ATK (static ATK + base ATK * bonus) in the live ATK percent zone, verified by exact 11/10 damage scaling at T1.
Exact expiry precedes equal-time hits (BuffManager rule: expired when now_us >= expires_at_us).

Lakshana packets delivered while the window is active hit an explicit unsupported return condition because the Remora/Stain target condition has no engine model; no silent zero or unconditional bonus.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
